title: Team budget pools with real block enforcement at invocation creation
spec: Budgets exist per user but teams need shared pools: a team budget with a cap that actually BLOCKS new invocation creation when the pool is exhausted (not just a warning), while still allowing explicitly exempted runs. Add team budget pool records, aggregate team spend against the pool, enforce the block in the invocation creation path with a clear operator-facing error, expose pool status in the public state read model, and unit-test the enforcement (cap hit blocks; under cap allows).
